site.name: 64Hz Toolchain
site.description: DreamShader, DreamFX, DreamTexture and twenty-odd open source plugins — an Unreal Engine toolchain that keeps materials, VFX and textures as source.

hero.eyebrow: Unreal Engine content pipeline · 64Hz Games Studio
hero.lede: Three languages keep materials, VFX and textures as source; {count} plugins fill in what the engine leaves out. One idea runs through all of it:
hero.ledeStrong: the source file is the authoring surface, the asset is build output

product.roundTripNote: Byte-identical after a round trip — the asset is not a one-way product

plugins.title: Plugin Library
plugins.hint: Move across the wall — the further forward a tile sits, the more stars it has.

vscode.d: One each for DreamShaderLang and DreamFX: highlighting, completion, diagnostics, package management, material preview.

rider.d: The same language support inside Rider, in the window your C++ already lives in.

mcp.d: Routes builds to a running editor, removing a 12–24s cold commandlet and the silent double-write; answers module signatures in milliseconds.

registry.d: math · color · noise · pbr · normal · sdf · uv · texture · postprocess

blender.d: Blender's shader nodes ported to DreamShaderLang from the Cycles kernel, so both sides share the same maths.

apps.d: DreamUnrealManager, DreamTranslatePO and DreamDSP are moving to their own site.

start.title: Put the tools in your project
start.s1: Drop the plugin into {dir}, enable it under Edit ▸ Plugins and restart the editor
start.s2: Create {dir} in the project root and add your first .dsm file
start.s3: Save. Auto-compile is on by default, and the asset is already in the engine
start.sub: Pick a plugin and a version — the command and the download follow

get.noteTitle: Most of these are not precompiled.
get.noteBody: They ship as source — drop one into Plugins/ and the engine builds it on the next compile; regenerate project files first if yours is a C++ project. Only {prebuilt} of the {total} repositories publish a packaged build you can use as-is.
